installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl jq unzip wget default-jre

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${MC_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MC_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    MC_VERSION=$(curl -sSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game | jq -r '.[] | select(.stable==true)|.version' | head -n1)
elif [ "${MC_VERSION}" == "snapshot" ]; then
    MC_VERSION=$(curl -sSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game | jq -r '.[] | select(.stable==false)|.version' | head -n1)
fi

if [ -z "${FABRIC_VERSION}" ] || [ "${FABRIC_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    FABRIC_VERSION=$(curl -sSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | jq -r '.[0].version')
fi

if [ -z "${LOADER_VERSION}" ] || [ "${LOADER_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    LOADER_VERSION=$(curl -sSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | jq -r '.[] | select(.stable==true)|.version' | head -n1)
elif [ "${LOADER_VERSION}" == "snapshot" ]; then
    LOADER_VERSION=$(curl -sSL https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | jq -r '.[] | select(.stable==false)|.version' | head -n1)
fi

echo -e "Installing Fabric v${FABRIC_VERSION} (Loader: ${LOADER_VERSION}) for Minecraft v${MC_VERSION}"
if ! wget -O fabric-installer.jar https://maven.fabricmc.net/net/fabricmc/fabric-installer/${FABRIC_VERSION}/fabric-installer-${FABRIC_VERSION}.jar; then
    echo "ERROR: Failed to download Fabric installer v${FABRIC_VERSION}"
    exit 1
fi

if ! java -jar fabric-installer.jar server -mcversion ${MC_VERSION} -loader ${LOADER_VERSION} -downloadMinecraft; then
    echo "ERROR: Fabric installer failed for MC ${MC_VERSION} + Fabric ${FABRIC_VERSION} + Loader ${LOADER_VERSION}"
    exit 1
fi

if [ -f "fabric-server-launch.jar" ]; then
    mv server.jar minecraft-server.jar
    mv fabric-server-launch.jar server.jar
    echo "serverJar=minecraft-server.jar" > fabric-server-launcher.properties
fi

rm -f fabric-installer.jar

echo ""
echo "=================================================="
echo "                   YuraCloud                      "
echo "=================================================="
echo " UUID Server   : ${P_SERVER_UUID}"
echo " Versi Fabric  : ${FABRIC_VERSION}"
echo " Loader Fabric : ${LOADER_VERSION}"
echo " Port Listen   : ${SERVER_PORT}"
echo "=================================================="


mkdir -p YuraCloud/data

if [ "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" = "auto" ] || [ -z "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" ]; then
	RANDOM_HOUR=$(shuf -i 0-2 -n 1)
	RANDOM_MINUTE=$(shuf -i 0-59 -n 1)
	RESTART_TIME=$(printf "%02d:%02d" $RANDOM_HOUR $RANDOM_MINUTE)
	RESTART_MODE="Auto-generated"
elif echo "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" | grep -qE '([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'; then
	RESTART_TIME="${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}"
	RESTART_MODE="Admin-defined"
else
	RANDOM_HOUR=$(shuf -i 0-2 -n 1)
	RANDOM_MINUTE=$(shuf -i 0-59 -n 1)
	RESTART_TIME=$(printf "%02d:%02d" $RANDOM_HOUR $RANDOM_MINUTE)
	RESTART_MODE="Auto-generated (invalid time)"
fi

echo "Server akan restart otomatis pada jam $RESTART_TIME WIB" > YuraCloud/data/autorestart.txt
echo "inactive" > YuraCloud/data/autorestart_status.txt
echo "[INSTALL] Auto-restart schedule: $RESTART_TIME WIB ($RESTART_MODE)" >> YuraCloud/data/restart.log

echo " Terima kasih sudah membeli hosting di yura cloud "
echo "=================================================="
